notes.title: Beer! now available on MacOS
notes.content:
Beer! is now available on MacOS, just like our other games Heroine's Quest, A Tale of Two Kingdoms, and the Crystal Shard Adventure Bundle. The Mac build uses Adventure Game Studio version 3.6.1.25, and should run on any Mac 64-bit computer running MacOS 10.15 or above. The Windows and Linux builds have not been changed.

Gameplay has not changed, but I'll consider a patch later this year if the Mac users (or anyone else) finds some major bugs. Enjoy, everyone, and have a great spring!

notes.title: Beer! updated to newest AGS engine
notes.content:
Beer! has been updated to the latest stable version of Adventure Game Studio, 3.6.0 patch 6. This will improve stability on newer computers and compatibility with newer Windows versions.

A full list of engine changes can be [url=https://www.adventuregamestudio.co.uk/forums/ags-engine-editor-releases/ags-3-6-0-patch-6/]found here[/url].

notes.title: Beer for Linux
notes.content: The Steam version of Beer! now includes a Linux package. This has been tested for Ubuntu but should work under most common distros.
